findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body: Returning `true` unconditionally authorizes users to read documents belonging to any tenant. This removes the prior tenant equality check and creates a direct cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The full PR diff shows this replaces `userTenant === documentTenant`, so cross-tenant reads remain authorized.
